title: Grateful Dead Live at Fox Theater on 1985-10-28
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz)> dBpoweramp (24/96) > Adobe Audition CC 2019 > TLH flac2496
source: Michael Hessberg's Master (FOB) Cassettes; Sennheiser ME-80 mics > Sony D5M

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording of an amazing acoustic set at the Fox, captured with a top‑notch Sennheiser ME‑80 pull.
ai_review.review: The reviewers rave about the superb acoustic performance and describe this Sennheiser ME‑80 audience pull as the best among several sources. The sound is clear and lively, making the concert a standout listening experience despite the lack of specific song details.

ai_rating.rationale: A single 5‑star review praises both the performance and the recording, indicating an outstanding show with excellent audio quality; however, limited data reduces confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sennheiser ME‑80 pull praised as the best of several sources – clear, balanced acoustic capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic set highlighted for its overall vibe and energy; no specific issues noted.
